recentItems.title: Heritage Month | Africa Mpanza on upcoming Ugu Maskandi Festival
recentItems.description:
September is Heritage Month, a time for South Africans to celebrate the country's rich cultural diversity and reconnect with their roots. Living heritage plays an important role in preserving traditions, promoting social cohesion and strengthening communities.

As part of this year's celebrations, various events are being planned across the country. Today, we look at KwaZulu-Natal, where a number of music and cultural festivals are being organised, including the Ugu Maskandi Festival and the Ilembe Heritage Experience. 

For more on this we are joined by event organisers Africa Mpanza of the Illembe Heritage Festival and Siyabonga Mkhungo of the Ugu Music Festival.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Steve Biko Day | Reflecting on the life of the Black Consciousness Movement leader
recentItems.description:
Azapo President Nelvis Qekema says the seventh democratic local government elections should be about the full restoration of the dignity of black people living in squalor, over three decades after attaining freedom.

He insists this would be a fitting tribute to the late Black Consciousness Movement Leader, Steve Biko. 

The apartheid government killed Biko on the 12th of September, 1977.

Our Politics Reporter Ntebo Mokobo has more.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: SAFA holds its Elective Congress
recentItems.description:
The future of South African football governance will be in the spotlight in Midrand today, headlined by a turbulent SAFA Elective Congress.
 
SAFA president, Danny Jordaan, is seeking a fourth consecutive term - he's up against a confident Amazulu Chairman, Sandile Zungu.

SABC News Sports Reporter Percy Nkatlo is there for us.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: LGE 2026 | ANC mobilises Mayihlome Volunteers ahead of November polls
recentItems.description:
ANC Secretary-General Fikile Mbalula is expected to address the Mayihlome Volunteers Assembly in Kimberly this Saturday, as the ANC intensifies its preparations ahead of the November elections.

The assembly is expected to focus on mobilising volunteers and strengthening the party's campaign machinery on the ground. 

Mbalula's engagement comes as the ANC looks to consolidate its support base and energise its structures in the province in the build-up to the polls. 

SABC News Reporter Ulrich Hendricks has more for us.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: LGE 2026 | EFF continues manifesto launch tour in Free State
recentItems.description:
The Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF) is launching its provincial manifesto at the Mangaung Outdoor Sports Centre in Bloemfontein, Free State.

The party is set to outline its priorities and plans for the Free State ahead of the upcoming elections, as it seeks to consolidate support and rally voters in the province.

SABC News reporter Ishmael Modiba has more on that story.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Music | Kaylow releases new single 'eKhaya'
recentItems.description:
Kelello "Kaylow" Segoana has spent over a decade establishing himself as a premium vocal fixture in the South African music scene.

He has recently inspired many through an incredible journey of resilience. After surviving a near-fatal car crash that left him in the ICU and temporarily wheelchair-bound, he underwent intensive physical rehabilitation to relearn how to walk and use his limbs. 

He has since made a triumphant return to the studio. His new single "eKhaya" featuring Chymamusique and Lulo Café is out and he joins us to share more on his latest offering.

 For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Participants gather for Barberton Makhonjwa 4-in-1 Marathon in Mpumalanga
recentItems.description:
The Makhonjwa four-in-one Marathon takes place in Barbeton, Mpumalanga today. 

It is a qualifying event for both the Comrades Marathon and the Two Oceans Marathon, making it a significant race for athletes aiming to participate in these major South African endurance events. 

The event features four race options, 42.2km, 21.1km, 10km, and 4.9km.

SABC News Reporter Tumelo Machogo joins us live from the event.

 For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: FF Plus leader launches LGE manifesto
recentItems.description:
Freedom Front Plus leader Corné Mulder will deliver the keynote address at the launch of the party's manifesto for the 2026 Local Government Elections in Pretoria.

The party says it will focus on turning around struggling municipalities if given an opportunity to govern. 

SABC News Reporter Zara Groenewald is there for us.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.
